newsitem.title: UK: Pace Aviation sets ups Frankfurt GSA office.
newsitem.headline: Pace Aviation sets ups Frankfurt GSA office.

text.p: Pace Aviation Services said it has opened a wholly-owned general sales agent office in Frankfurt as part of its European expansion plans.

Pace already acts as GSA for Ukraine International Airlines across Europe and the new office will market the airline's airport-to-door cargo services in the Ukraine to German manufacturers of machine tools and heavy project equipment.
Mac Warner, Pace's managing director, told Reuters: "We will launch a weekly ex-Frankfurt to Kiev service on May 11 using a 15 tonne Antonov AN-12 freighter."

The aircraft will also be targeted at the quick response market, providing support for express companies and small consolidators. Ukraine International already operates a daily Boeing 737-300 service between Frankfurt and Kiev.
Warner added there are also two weekly AN-12 freighters flights from Amsterdam to the Ukrainian capital. A wide range of cargo is carried including telecommunications and electronics equipment.
Other GSA offices may be opened Europe during the next 12 months, "But first we want to establish ourselves in the German market," he said.
Manager of the new Pace operation, based at Frankfurt's Cargo City, is Ebru Wilson who was previously TWA's acting manager sales and services for Germany and Austria.
